content: If CanTSynGlobalTimeDebounceTime ( ECUC_CanTSyn_00045 : ) is greater than 0 for a Time Base , CanTSyn shall always do debouncing for the corresponding Timesync PDUs as described below, otherwise CanTSyn shall not do any debouncing .
